description: This source file defines the internal class 'RelationalOrleansQueries' which provides methods to interact with Orleans storage related to membership, reminders, streaming, and grain directory data using ADO.NET. It includes methods for reading, writing, updating, and deleting various Orleans metadata in a relational database, supporting different storage types via conditional compilation.

classes.name: RelationalOrleansQueries
classes.description: Internal class providing database interaction methods for Orleans storage components such as membership, reminders, streaming, and grain directory, supporting relational database backends through conditional compilation.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of 'RelationalOrleansQueries' and initializes Orleans queries from the database.

methods.name: ReadReminderRowsAsync
methods.description: Reads Orleans reminders for a specific grain or service, returning reminder table data.

methods.name: ReadReminderRowAsync
methods.description: Reads a specific reminder entry for a grain.

methods.name: UpsertReminderRowAsync
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder row.

methods.name: DeleteReminderRowAsync
methods.description: Deletes a specific reminder row.

methods.name: DeleteReminderRowsAsync
methods.description: Deletes all reminder rows for a service.

methods.name: ActiveGatewaysAsync
methods.description: Lists active gateway URIs for a deployment.

methods.name: MembershipReadRowAsync
methods.description: Reads a specific membership entry for a silo.

methods.name: MembershipReadAllAsync
methods.description: Reads all membership entries for a deployment.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntriesAsync
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries for a deployment.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntriesAsync
methods.description: Removes defunct silo entries based on their last alive time.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAliveTimeAsync
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a silo.

methods.name: InsertMembershipVersionRowAsync
methods.description: Inserts a version row for deployment tracking.

methods.name: InsertMembershipRowAsync
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry.

methods.name: UpdateMembershipRowAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing membership entry.

methods.name: RegisterGrainActivationAsync
methods.description: Registers a new grain activation in the directory.

methods.name: UnregisterGrainActivationAsync
methods.description: Unregisters a grain activation.

methods.name: LookupGrainActivationAsync
methods.description: Looks up a grain activation.

methods.name: UnregisterGrainActivationsAsync
methods.description: Unregisters all grain activations for specified silos.

methods.name: QueueStreamMessageAsync
methods.description: Queues a stream message.

methods.name: GetStreamMessagesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves stream messages.

methods.name: ConfirmStreamMessagesAsync
methods.description: Confirms delivery of stream messages.

methods.name: FailStreamMessageAsync
methods.description: Handles failing a stream message, e.g., moving to dead letters.

methods.name: EvictStreamMessagesAsync
methods.description: Evicts messages from the stream message table to dead letter storage.

methods.name: EvictStreamDeadLettersAsync
methods.description: Removes expired dead letter messages.
